nodes.label: Stale Party Roster Defect
nodes.rationale: summaryPlayers combined the dungeon roster with global party UUIDs and cached player rows, admitting three stale players with no dungeon class row. The fix restricts the source instead of truncating an arbitrary eight-player summary to five rows.

nodes.label: Shared Secrets Found Misattribution
nodes.rationale: The tab parser labelled the shared integer Secrets Found as personal, overwriting even an API-derived value and advertising the party total to peers as a self-report. Skyblocker treats the same position as the shared display, so it now updates party counts only.

nodes.label: secretsSource Provenance Tag
nodes.rationale: Sync reports carry API_DELTA or PERSONAL and untagged legacy reports are rejected so an older peer cannot reintroduce the party-as-personal count. Only a local measurement is sent, received reports are never forwarded, and missing or negative counts stay unknown rather than becoming zero.
